title: InspectionResult
description: Result of a package inspection operation, including expected object counts and any problems identified.

status.description: The current status of the inspection operation.

ImportSummaryCount.description: Summary count of items in an import deployment, showing total, imported, failed, and skipped counts.

total.description: Total number of items in the package.

failed.description: Number of items that failed to import.

skipped.description: Number of items skipped during import.

InspectionError.description: An error identified during package inspection that would prevent successful deployment.

errorMessage.description: A description of the error condition.

objectName.description: The name of the object affected by the error.

objectUuid.description: The UUID of the object affected by the error.

InspectionProblems.description: Collection of errors and warnings identified during a package inspection.

totalErrors.description: Total number of errors found during inspection.

totalWarnings.description: Total number of warnings found during inspection.

errors.description: Array of error details identified during inspection.

warnings.description: Array of warning details identified during inspection.

InspectionWarning.description: A warning identified during package inspection that may affect deployment but would not prevent it.

warningMessage.description: A description of the warning condition.

objectName.description: The name of the object associated with the warning.

objectUuid.description: The UUID of the object associated with the warning.
